spec.title: Statutory Framework of Corporate Amalgamations under Section 2(1B) and Section 72A

steps.caption: Statutory amalgamations transfer all assets to acquirers.

Tax neutral mergers exempt asset transfers from immediate capital gains.

spec.title: Demergers and Spinoffs: Section 2(19AA) Conditions & Tax Neutrality

steps.caption: Demergers carve out operating undertakings on a going concern basis.
Assets and liabilities transfer at historical book values.
Proportionate share issuances preserve equity ownership ratios.
Allocated business losses transfer to the resulting operating company.

steps.caption: Slump sales transfer whole business undertakings for a single lump sum.
Net worth calculations deduct book liabilities from total asset values.

Independent accountant reports certify statutory net worth computations.

steps.caption: Successor entities inherit unexpired balances of statutory tax holidays.

spec.title: Anti-Abuse Provisions: Section 79 Change in Shareholding & Loss Forfeiture Exceptions

steps.caption: Fifty one percent voting power continuity polices corporate tax losses.
